reuse.why: Adds the check inside the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked pre-link guard that all six link handlers already call before any write or sync-server call.

duplication.why: One check in one function; nothing is copied into the individual link handlers.

placement.why: Right layer (the shared link guard in accounts/app.ts), though the function name now understates what it asserts; a separate small assert or rename would read better.

maintainability.why: Simple and covers every link path; the guard's name no longer describes its full responsibility.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Goes through the existing shared guard.

one_place.where: accounts/app.ts assertBankAccountNotLinked, called by every link*Account handler with upgradingId.
